appraisal_events.evidence: « Hé bien, si vous les connaissez, en quoi avez-vous besoin de moi pour vous présenter », me répondit-il d'un ton claquant, et, me tournant le dos, il reprit sa partie feinte.
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus curtly rebuffs the narrator's request and turns his back on him, a direct staged dismissal of the narrator as a social participant seeking his help.

appraisal_events.evidence: le prince de Guermantes, au lieu de recevoir sur place le bonsoir du mari d'Odette, l'avait aussitôt... entraîné avec lui au fond du jardin, même, dirent certaines personnes, « afin de le mettre à la porte ».
appraisal_events.explanation: Instead of greeting Swann normally, the Prince immediately sweeps him off to the far end of the garden, an action some guests interpret as an effective expulsion, staging Swann's exclusion from the reception.

appraisal_events.evidence: je compris tout de suite que l'homme foncièrement dédaigneux était le duc qui vous parlait dès la première visite de « pair à compagnon », et que des deux cousins celui qui était vraiment simple c'était le Prince.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator concludes that the duc's famous affability masks a deeper disdain, contrasting unfavorably with the Prince's genuine, if formal, consideration, locally unmasking the duc's charm as hollow.

status_effects.explanation: Charlus's sharp refusal and turned back momentarily exclude the narrator from the help and access he sought.
Swann is denied a normal reception and is instead swept away, locally marking him as excluded from the gathering's valued space.
The narrator's reassessment reveals the duc's celebrated affability as concealing genuine disdain, lowering him in the narrator's local estimation relative to the Prince.

ambiguities: The reference to 'le jet d'eau d'Hubert Saint-Loup' does not clearly match any alias for Robert de Saint-Loup and carries no evaluative content about a person, so it was not treated as involving that character.
